daily_summary: 当日变更集中在 Ascend 后端的 DynamicCVPipeline（ssbuffer）同步复用重构、Proton profiling 在 Ascend NPU 上的完整接入（MSPTI + intra-kernel instrumentation）、TLA 语言层补齐 sqrt 算子，以及 CI 工作流调整（移除黄蓝流水线、新增 wheel/npuir 手动上传发布）。另有 launcher 锁初始化流序化修复、A3 目标 libdevice 算子扩展和一处 outline reuse 黑名单小修。整体是性能调优基础设施（同步复用、profiling）与发布/测试工程能力并进的一天。
test_impact_summary: 当日多个 commit 直接改动编译流水线语义与运行时 ABI：ssbuffer 同步复用重构新增了 loop depth/region 分析与 flag 复用规则，并附带 3 个新 MLIR 回归测试；Proton 接入改动了 launcher ABI（profile_scratch 参数）、compiler stage patch 钩子与 C++ pass 注册，新增大量 proton_ut 用例；A3 libdevice 与 tla.sqrt 属于新算子路径，需要覆盖新目标/新算子的端到端用例；launcher_cann 改为异步 memcpy 并新增锁模板缓存，影响启动路径正确性。现有测试在 commit 内部已同步更新/新增，但 ssbuffer 的 flag 复用边界条件、Proton 在无硬件环境下的 hookless 路径、以及 A3 目标上的 libdevice 算子数值正确性仍需重点看护；CI 侧改动不引入运行时测试点，但影响夜间构建与集成测试的包安装格式。

commits.comment: 在 isOutlineReuseBlacklistKernel 的黑名单中新增 chunk_kda_bwd_kernel_intra 与 flex_attention_kernel 两个 kernel。该函数决定 SSBUFFER（DynamicCVPipeline SplitDataflow）是否跳过 start/end sync 复用分析，属于对特定 kernel 的保守回退，防止复用逻辑在这两个 kernel 上产生错误同步。改动极小、风险低，但黑名单是硬编码字符串匹配，kernel 改名或新变体出现时会静默失去保护。

test_impact.reason: 仅向已有黑名单追加条目，属于保守回退开关，不影响接口与其他路径，现有 MLIR 回归可覆盖黑名单分支行为。

commits.comment: SSBUFFER 同步复用的大重构。核心变化：(1) 用 kill kLoopId 改为 kLoopDepthAttr/kLoopRegionAttr，在 AddBlockIdForControlOps 中通过 setOpLoopDepth 标记循环深度；(2) 新增 SyncAnalysis.{h,cpp}，把 sortDependencies 从 InterCoreTransferAndSync 移到 DataDependencyAnalysis，并新增 analyzeDepLoopInfo/analyzeSyncReuse，按 loop depth + loop region 分组，选取依赖数最多的 region 作为 master，其余 region 轮转复用其 flag id，复用依赖标记 reuseStartEnd=true；(3) 把 getBlockStartEnd 的四元组替换为 TransferSyncInsertPoint 结构体，贯穿 createTransferAllocs/insertVectorToCubeTransfer/insertCubeToVectorTransfer/insertInterCoreSync/insertMemDepSync；(4) 删除 analyzeLoopInclusion/moveStartEndSync 与旧 sortDependencies，改为 findLoopRange 计算 loopStartBound/loopEndBound；(5) AddMultiBufferOuterScope 增加共享 sync 生命周期校验（DominanceInfo/PostDominanceInfo），单 buffer 模式跳过校验，校验失败返回 rc=1；(6) 移除 collectExtraSync 的 fallback 兜底与在 loop 内 receiver wait 上重复插入 drain 的行为；(7) FlagIdManager 每次 acquireId/checkCurrentId 重新扫描已有 flag，避免 ID 冲突。意图是减少 SSBUFFER 中冗余的 sync flag 数量、提升双 buffer 复用效率，同时以保守失败代替静默降级。风险点：loops 嵌套与 if/else 分支场景下复用正确性依赖 dominate/post-dominate 证明，transfer group 缺失 lifecycle 时直接 fail 整个 pass；另外 transferIndex 与 dep.flagId 的绑定顺序依赖 sortDependencies 的稳定性，若 region 分组选主策略不当可能生成不必要同步。作者已同步补充 3 个 MLIR 测试（shared flag lifecycle、if-else reuse、parallel reuse）并调整 test_fill_init.mlir。

test_impact.reason: 重构了依赖排序、loop 深度分析、flag 复用与 transfer 插入点数据结构，属于编译语义变更，必须依赖新 MLIR 回归验证 flag 复用正确性与失败回退路径；本次提交已新增 Outer-scope-shared-flag-lifecycle.mlir、test_if_else_reuse.mlir、test_parallel_reuse.mlir 并修改 test_fill_init.mlir，但循环嵌套/多 region 交互的边界仍需补充。

commits.comment: 在 cann/libdevice.py 中把原本仅针对 A5/A6 目标的 __hmf_* 硬件函数路径扩展到 A3 目标（_is_a3_target），涉及 reciprocal/log1p/relu/isinf/ldexp/finitef/isnan/mulhi/div_rz/sqrt_rn/fast_dividef/fast_expf/sinh/cosh/acosh/asinh/atanh/expm1/nextafter/hypot/erf/lgamma/log10/copysign/abs/div_rn/exp/exp2/fma/log/log2/rsqrt/sqrt 等大量数学函数；同时把 mulhi/sinh/cosh/acosh/asinh/atanh/nextafter/hypot/erf/lgamma/copysign/rsqrt 从裸 extern_elementwise 改为 _libdevice_elementwise 并显式传 workspace（量、类型、whetherTrue）。意图是为 A3（Ascend910_9382）目标启用与 A5/A6 一致的硬件数学指令。风险点：A3 硬件是否真正支持所有 __hmf_* 符号需验证；workspace 元组参数若与目标硬件约束不符会导致编译失败或精度异常；mulhi 的 workspace=(6, int32, True) 等具体数值依赖硬件指令实现细节。

test_impact.reason: 新增 A3 目标上的大量数学函数硬件路径，需要针对 A3 硬件验证各 __hmf_* 符号可用性与数值正确性；现有测试若只在 A5/A6 上跑不会暴露 A3 路径问题。

commits.comment: launcher 锁初始化修复：把 cann_memcpy（同步）替换为 cann_memcpy_async 并传入 stream，新增 initializeLocks 用进程级静态 std::map 缓存 pinned host 模板（key 为 ordered/unordered locks、participants、lock_init_value），避免每次 launch 都构造 vector 并同步 memcpy；unordered_locks 与非零 lock_init_value 走模板 memcpy，否则走 memset_async。缓存永久保留是因为 queued copies 与 captured graphs 可能比首次 launch plan 生命周期更长。风险点：静态模板进程内永不释放（微量泄漏但设计上有意为之）；缓存 key 未包含 device/stream，若不同 device 的 lock 布局不同则存在问题（但 layout 由 spec 决定，应一致）；并发首次初始化由 mutex 保护。

test_impact.reason: launcher 锁初始化从同步改异步并引入缓存，需验证 unordered_locks、lock_init_value 各种组合在 stream 顺序下的正确性，以及重复 launch 时模板复用不产生脏状态。

commits.comment: Proton profiling 在 Ascend NPU 上的完整接入，规模最大的一次变更：(1) compiler.py 增加 AscendBackend.instrumentation 钩子，在 make_ttir/ttir_to_linalg stage 调用 patch，并从 ttadapter linalg 文本正则提取 profile_scratch_size/profile_num_units 等 metadata；NPUOptions 增加 profile_scratch_size；pack_metadata 透出 profile 字段。(2) driver.py：NPULauncher 按 profile_scratch_size 分配 profile scratch 并在 exit hook 前同步 torch_npu 队列；npu_utils.cpp 新增 get_vector_clock_rate/get_hbm_clock_rate（dlopen libascend_hal.so/libdrvdsmi_host.so，失败 warn 返回 0）。(3) launcher ABI 扩展：TritonNpuLaunchSpecV1 增加 profile_scratch_size，LaunchRequestV1 增加 profile_scratch，ArgLayout 新增 profile slot，launcher.py wrap_handle_tensordesc 支持 profile_scratch 参数。(4) 新增 Ascend 专有 C++ pass 目录 ProtonToHIVM（AssignAscendProtonScopeIds + LowerAscendProtonToHIVM，38 行核心 Pass 把 proton.record 降为 HIVM CustomOp __builtin_proton_circular_store，并注入 header/footer 时间戳与 metadata），CMake 通过 TRITON_BUILD_PROTON 门控。(5) proton_patch.patch 以 opt-in patch 形式把 CANN/MSPTI 后端、AscendRuntime、MsptiProfiler、AscendInstrumentation 等改动注入 third_party/proton，setup_patch.py 提供幂等 apply/reverse 与冲突检查。(6) 新增大量 proton_ut 测试（smoke、instrumentation、backend、lifecycle）。设计上沿用上游 proton 的 hook/patch 机制，Ascend 走非 ttgir 的 ttir→linalg 路径。主要风险：patch 与上游 proton 版本强耦合（git 区间 2a00c6052..be46d818e），上游升级会冲突；profile scratch 分配/释放依赖 torch_npu 与 _profile_allocator，stream 顺序与队列 drain 的时序正确性需硬件验证；新增 ABI 字段为向后兼容的尾插，但旧 launcher_export 路径已同步置 nullptr。

test_impact.reason: 跨 compiler/driver/launcher/C++ pass 的完整功能接入，已新增 proton_ut 系列测试与 ProtonToHIVM 三个 lit 用例，并更新 test_launcher_export_api.py/test_launcher_plan.py/test_knob.py/test_backend_npu_utils_build_flags.py 以适配新 ABI 与 -ldl；仍需关注无硬件环境的构建门控（REQUIRES: proton）、patch 幂等性和 A5/A3 不同 SoC 的 time shift 行为。

commits.message:
[CI](feat) add manual wheel upload and npuir payload OBS publish (#2868)

* Add a manual upload workflow for wheel packages

Adds upload-wheels.yml: a workflow_dispatch task that takes a list of
prebuilt wheel URLs (space/newline separated), downloads and validates
them, uploads each to the OBS nightly pypi directory with obsutil, and
regenerates index.html. Tested on the fork (URL splitting and per-file
obsutil cp fixes included).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Publish npuir payload to OBS as tarball on dispatch

Adds a publish-npuir-run job to npuir-build.yml, gated on
workflow_dispatch so the nightly schedule keeps producing GitHub
artifacts only and can never overwrite official releases:

- No input: build as usual, then publish the fresh payload.
- npuir_run_id given: skip the build and publish that earlier
  successful run's artifacts instead.

The payload (bin/, lib/, npuir-sha.txt) is packed into a plain tar.gz
and uploaded with obsutil to obs://triton-ascend-artifacts/cann/, named
ascendnpu-ir_<ver>_linux-<arch>[-<tag>].tar.gz after the official .run
releases' filename scheme. An existing object is never replaced unless
overwrite_existing is set.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Pin EPEL to the Huawei Cloud mirror in the npuir toolchain step

The runners' egress proxy serves stale EPEL metalink metadata and the
overseas mirrors 404 on the hashed repodata files, so 'yum install
ccache' intermittently fails (seen on the aarch64 build). Add a
dedicated epel-hwcloud repo pointing at mirrors.huaweicloud.com,
disable the metalink-based epel repo for the install, retry up to
three times, and verify the packages with rpm -q afterwards.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add npuir tarball upload from prebuilt wheels

Add an opt-in Upload-Npuir job to the wheel upload workflow: it
downloads the same wheel_urls, extracts the AscendNPU-IR (bishengir)
payload bundled in each triton_ascend wheel, and publishes one
ascendnpu-ir_<version>_linux-<arch>[-<tag>].tar.gz tarball per
architecture to obs://triton-ascend-artifacts/cann/. The naming,
archive layout and overwrite guard follow npuir-build.yml's
publish-npuir-run job.

Controlled by four new dispatch inputs: upload_npuir (default false),
npuir_version (default 2.0.0), npuir_tag (default empty) and
npuir_overwrite (default false).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Support tar.gz Bisheng packages in integration tests

The Bisheng compiler install step now accepts two package formats,
selected by the file extension of the entry pinned in
cmake/bisheng-version.txt: the official .run self-extracting
installer, and plain .tar.gz payload tarballs with bin/, lib/ and
manifest.xml at the archive root, as published by npuir-build.yml and
upload-wheels.yml into the cann/ directory. Fail early with a clear
message when bishengir-compile is missing after install.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add wheel version rewrite and latest/ refresh to the upload workflow

Sync upload-wheels.yml with the full version running on the fork:

- new_version input (default "auto"): rewrite wheel versions before
  uploading. "auto" keeps the build date but drops the time
  (3.6.0+dev20261027220530 -> 3.6.0+dev20261027); an explicit version
  applies to every wheel; "" uploads the wheels unmodified. The repack
  carries each entry's timestamp, unix mode bits and compression method
  over from the source wheel, so executables (triton-opt, *.so) keep
  +x through the rewrite, and regenerates RECORD accordingly.
- update_latest input: mirror this upload's wheels into the latest/
  subfolder, prune stale objects there and regenerate its index.html.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Remove the update_latest input and latest/ mirror

The latest/ subfolder mirror is no longer needed; drop the
update_latest dispatch input, the UPDATE_LATEST env wiring and the
upload/prune/index-regeneration block from the upload step. The main
directory upload and its index.html regeneration are unchanged.
